claim: users.last_study_date / users.current_streak are stale after the SQL cutover, and AdminService dashboard still reads them
area: Phase 1 — SQL Server data-layer audit (parity, constraint effectiveness, orphans, streak schema, index usage, timezone)
verdict: NOT REFUTED — every material assertion reproduced against the live stack with real DB rows, real source, and a real HTTP response. One sub-number in the claim's window table is wrong, but it does not change the finding.
severity_note: Real but tightly bounded: the only live consumer is a single admin-dashboard stat ('Học trong 7 ngày') plus a dead column. No user-facing, security, or data-integrity impact; the scheduler already reads study_days. MEDIUM is defensible as a top bound; LOW is the accurate label. Severity does not affect whether the claim holds.
what_i_tried_to_refute: Hypothesis A — 'a writer exists that keeps last_study_date in sync, so the column is not actually stale.' REFUTED AS A DEFENCE: 0 writers in src/main/java. Grep for setLastStudyDate|setCurrentStreak over src/main/java returns only the @Column fields in User.java; every setter call site is a test fixture (StreakReminderSchedulerTest, StudyActivityServiceTest, StudySqlIntegrationTest, UserServiceStudyActivityTest). No native UPDATE in src/main/resources, no @PreUpdate/@PrePersist/EntityListeners on User, no trigger on the users table.
Hypothesis B — 'a DB trigger or computed column re-syncs the legacy column.' REFUTED: SELECT name FROM sys.triggers returned 0 rows; no computed column on users.

Hypothesis C — 'the admin stat the claim names is not actually wired to the legacy column / the frontend does not show it.' REFUTED: AdminService.java:51 is exactly countByLastStudyDateAfter(...); AdminStatsDTO.recentUsers is built from it (line 60); AdminDashboard.vue:64 renders it as the label 'Học trong 7 ngày'. Live GET /api/admin/stats returned recentUsers:2, matching the legacy-column count.

Hypothesis D — 'the reminder scheduler still uses the stale column, so the blast radius is bigger than the claim admits.' REFUTED: StreakReminderScheduler -> streakService.getUsersWithStreakAtRisk()/getUsersWithBrokenStreak() -> StudyActivityService.reminderCandidates() -> findStudyReminderAtRisk/findStudyReminderBroken, both of which subquery StudyDay (study_days), not users.last_study_date. The three legacy queries findUsersWhoHaveNotLoggedInSince / findUsersWithBrokenStreak / findActiveUsersWhoLastStudiedOn have 0 references in src/main/java.

Hypothesis E — 'the numbers are a probe artefact (a self-caused 429, a scrollbar false positive, a guard redirect).' REFUTED: this is a data-layer finding; the only HTTP call was a single admin login + GET /api/admin/stats after flushing rate_limit:* buckets. No 429, no UI geometry involved.

no_writer_in_main.result: 0 hits in src/main/java; hits only in 4 test classes

current_streak_column_is_dead.grep: User.getCurrentStreak() has 0 readers in src/main/java; every currentStreak value in DTOs comes from StreakService/StudyActivityService

legacy_queries_unreferenced.result: each declared once in UserRepository.java, 0 call sites in src/main/java

scheduler_path_is_new.note: Matches the claim: reminder mail is NOT in the blast radius

reproduced_db_facts.sql_runner: python sweep/v8/sqlrun.py <file.sql> (docker exec engflow-sqlserver sqlcmd, db english_learning)

users_vs_study_days.sql: SELECT user_id,username,last_study_date,current_streak FROM users WHERE user_id IN (2,3); SELECT user_id,MAX(study_date),COUNT(*) FROM study_days GROUP BY user_id;
users_vs_study_days.consequence: user 2 legacy last_study_date=2026-09-19 vs truth 2026-09-22; legacy current_streak=1 vs truth streak=2. Claim's headline numbers are exact.

window_comparison_app_date_2026-09-22.semantics: legacy = COUNT(*) users WHERE last_study_date > (today - N); truth = COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) study_days WHERE study_date >= (today - N + 1)  [inclusive of the N-day window]
window_comparison_app_date_2026-09-22.correction_to_claim: The claim states 3d -> '2 vs 2' (agree). Measured 3d -> legacy 0 vs truth 2 (DIVERGE). The divergence is therefore already visible at 3d, not only at 2d/1d as the claim's table implies. Direction and mechanism are correct; that one sub-number is wrong.
window_comparison_app_date_2026-09-22.note_on_1d: With strict '>' on both sides the truth count at 1d is 1 (only 2026-09-22); with an inclusive N-day window it is 2. Immaterial to the finding.

live_http_evidence.flush: docker exec engflow-redis redis-cli --scan --pattern 'rate_limit:*' | del each (before the batch)
live_http_evidence.reading: recentUsers=2 equals the legacy-column count (last_study_date > 2026-09-15) exactly; it is served to the admin dashboard labelled 'Học trong 7 ngày'. Confirms the stale column is live-read through the real API.

answers_to_the_posed_questions.is_evidence_real_and_reproducible: Yes. Source lines, DB rows and the live HTTP body all reproduce. Not a probe artefact.
answers_to_the_posed_questions.is_claimed_severity_justified: Partially. The finding is real but the blast radius is one admin stat + one dead column, currently coincidentally correct at 7d (2 vs 2), with no security/data-integrity/user-facing effect. LOW is the accurate severity; MEDIUM is a defensible upper bound. Corrected to LOW.
answers_to_the_posed_questions.is_this_correct_behaviour: No — it is a genuine defect, not intended behaviour. The comment on UserRepository.java:56 explicitly labels the legacy queries as retained for compatibility, and AdminService reads a column that nothing in the new write path maintains, so the stat will silently drift (it already diverges at 3d).

not_refuted_reasons: AdminService.java:51 reads users.last_study_date (legacy) — source-verified and live-verified via GET /api/admin/stats.
Nothing writes last_study_date/current_streak in main code, and no DB trigger/computed column compensates.
Live rows show the exact divergence the claim states (user 2: 09-19 vs 09-22; user 3: 09-19 vs 09-21).
Blast radius is correctly scoped by the claim: scheduler uses study_days-backed queries; legacy queries are unreferenced.
corrections: Claim window table: 3d is legacy 0 vs truth 2 (diverges), not '2 vs 2'. The stale window already shows at 3d.
Severity: corrected from MEDIUM to LOW (bounded, non-user-facing, currently coincidentally correct at the 7d window the app actually uses).
